levels.decide: Role decides; the work itself is the record
levels.decide-inform: Role decides and records it (PR, register entry); founder may read, need not act
levels.recommend-approve: Role recommends; the named approver decides (DACI)
levels.escalate: Founder decides (RAPID for the few with vetoes)

note: Template for every entity. An entity may tighten a class (move it up a level) in <entity>/_meta/registers/decision-rights.json; loosening needs a founder decision.
